title: Launch Captain — Preflight 15m Solo Notes
content:
Context:
- Quick solo run-through before the 15m ops sync. I'm the Launch Captain for the candidate 2025-11-15 (feature roll + infra changes). Use this as my cheat-sheet for the meeting and the immediate followups.

Agenda (15m):
1) Quick health snapshot (30s)
2) Go/no-go checklist readout (6m)
3) High risks & mitigations (4m)
4) Owners & immediate actions (3m)

Quick health snapshot (notes to self):
- CI: green (last deploy 02:01 UTC), small flaky test (infra/smoke-test) opened LAUNCH-4121.
- Infra: all clusters in us-west healthy, one spot instance difference for caching nodes (expected, covered by autoscale).
- Data/metrics: pre-release traffic sim completed, 95th percentile latency +8% vs baseline (acceptable).

Go / No-Go checklist (call status = MY READOUT -> meeting will confirm):
- API endpoint readiness (owner: Diego) -> OK (smoke pass, rate limit config verified).
- DB migrations (owner: Maya) -> WARNING (non-blocking: long-running BACKFILL planned, run in maintenance window; final cutover plan required).
- Feature flags (owner: Priya) -> OK (can toggle per region).
- Canary traffic route (owner: infra-team) -> OK (canary in eu-central scheduled).
- Observability & alerts (owner: SRE) -> OK (alert playbook added).
- Secrets/KMS (owner: security) -> OK (key rotation complete, keys in vault).
- Rollback plan confirmed (owner: release-eng) -> OK (downgradeable to previous model, DB rollback steps doc exists).
- Legal/compliance signoff (owner: legal) -> NO RESPONSE (needs confirmation; treat as WARN until cleared).

My short status summary: GO if legal confirmation arrives before the 15m; otherwise HOLD for 1h.

Top risks & mitigations (what I'll call out):
- Risk: DB backfill could spike write latency.
  - Mitigation: schedule backfill outside of peak window + throttling. Escalation: on-call DB eng (Maya).
- Risk: Model variant fallback mismatch (edge-case outputs).
  - Mitigation: enable conservative reroute to stable model; disable new quantized variant for tier-A customers if regressions show up.
- Risk: Missing legal signoff for telemetry collection.
  - Mitigation: Delay telemetry enablement; deploy without the new metrics and toggle on post-approval.

Immediate actions (post-meeting if GO):
- Diego: finalize endpoint headers + throttles (due: in 1h).
- Maya: freeze migrations that touch core tables until after maintenance window; circulate final plan (due: 30m).
- Priya: confirm FF gating rules and ensure default is OFF for enterprise customers (due: 30m).
- SRE: confirm alert escalation phone list and runbook link (due: 45m).
- Me (Ava): send final go/no-go note to #launch-ops and update runbook with any changes (due: 15m after meeting).

Questions I want answered in the sync (call these out early):
- Legal: where is the telemetry signoff? ETA? (If no ETA, we default to no telemetry.)
- PM: are any enterprise customers explicitly excluded from rollout? (affects FF defaults)
- Sales/Ops: any expected large customer migrations during the window? (if yes, reschedule)

Notes-to-self / reminders:
- Keep the meeting tight — this is a coordination readout, not a deep tech dive.
- If I hear >1 WARN item I call HOLD and ask for a 30m focused followup subgroup.
- Maintain single source of truth: update the launch candidate Confluence doc after any change.

After-meeting followups (if HOLD):
- Spin up subgroup channel: #launch-ops-preflight-urgent (invite: Diego, Maya, Priya, SRE lead, legal rep).
- Triage WARN items, assign owners, target a next-check at +30m.

Rollback and contingency quick-code: (short checklist for paging)
- Disable new feature flags (Priya)
- Re-route traffic to stable model (infra)
- Trigger DB emergency stop and safe-mode writes (Maya)
- Notify customers (comms template in Confluence)

Personal follow-ups / 1:1 notes (for later):
- 1:1 with Maya this week: discuss improving migration observability and shorter backfill strategies.
- 1:1 with Diego: review endpoint throttling defaults and more aggressive canary scale-down.

Final micro-plan for the 15m:
- 00:00 — quick health snapshot (me)
- 00:30 — read checklist (me)
- 06:30 — owners confirm (each owner 30–45s)
- 10:30 — call out risks & contingency (me)
- 12:30 — final call: GO/HOLD + immediate actions (me)

Scratchpad brain (randoms I might say):
- "If legal doesn't respond, rescind telemetry and ship — keep customer-facing changes minimal"
- "Prioritize rollback simplicity over minor perf gains"

End of notes. Keep this doc as my single-person preflight scratchpad. Update after the sync with timestamps and final status.
